sections.Profile:
Happy Clown, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1964, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a circus theme. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game is notable for its animated backglass, where a clown's head moves up and down as players score points.
